llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must represent collapsed/expanded states with a Reanimated progress shared value (for example `0`/`1`) and map it to card height via `interpolate(...)` in `useAnimatedStyle`.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: Uses a boolean shared value (useSharedValue(false)) instead of a numeric progress value (0/1), and uses withSpring() inline inside useAnimatedStyle rather than interpolate() to map progress to height.

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Header press must toggle the progress shared value between collapsed/expanded states using `withSpring(...)` from `react-native-reanimated`.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: withSpring() is used inside useAnimatedStyle to animate opacity, scaleY, and height on toggle. The toggle function flips the shared value, driving the spring animation.

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Card/details visuals must be driven by Reanimated animated styles (`Animated.View` + `useAnimatedStyle`) instead of direct non-animated React style toggles.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: Details content is wrapped in Animated.View with animatedDetailsStyle from useAnimatedStyle, so visibility is driven by Reanimated animated styles rather than conditional React rendering or direct style toggles.
